subject: Duplicate dates in part 2 day summary

messages.author: f96d0f7edf7a550a
messages.subject: Duplicate dates in part 2 day summary
parts:
First of all, thanks a lot for making GGIR possible and all the hard work that must have gone into it. It's much appreciated.

I am using it to process GENEActiv .bin files which contain data for several days. My main objective is to identify the number of valid hours for each day. For that purpose, I've run parts 1 and 2 with qwindow = c(0, 24). I am using the "part2_daysummary" CSV for my analysis.

When checking the output I noticed unexpected results in the "calendar_date" and "N hours" columns. An example is attached. It appears that there is an issue with the last day, which happens consistently across 60 analysed files. 

The example shows recorded GENEActiv data for 15 days. This is accurately captured in the "measurementday" column. However, in the "calendar_date" column the last entry appears to be wrong. I expected 2020-12-26T00:00:00+0000 but it is recorded as 2020-12-25T23:59:55+0000. Furthermore, the "N hours" column says the day had 24.001 hours. 

This pattern appears consistently across all 60 files - the last day always has 24.001 hours and the date incorrectly shows as a duplicate of the previous day at T23:59:55. 

My code:

GGIR(datadir = "path to several GENEActiv .bin files",
     outputdir = "path to output folder",
     mode = 1:2, # Run GGIR parts 1 and 2
     do.report = 2, # Generate csv-report for GGIR part 2
     qwindow = c(0, 24)) # Analyse midnight to midnight (full day segments only)

Have I overlooked something or is this a bug?

Best regards,
Alex
